title: SideNavigation
description: Fiori side navigation: groups, items and sub-items as a keyboard tree; collapsed icon mode with sub-item popovers and a height-aware overflow menu; fixed footer items (ui5-side-navigation).

usage.summary: Provide the main navigation between modules or destinations within a product.
useWhen: Let users move between multiple application destinations from a persistent vertical navigation.
Group related destinations and expose sub-items when the navigation has a hierarchy.
Label the first destination Home and link it to the entry page; keep any footer action focused on the essential task.

avoidWhen.when: Offer related destinations from a single opener without a persistent sidebar.
Switch facets of content within one page rather than application destinations.
Switch to a different product rather than navigate within the current one.
Show the current location and return to ancestors in its navigation path.
Arrange the shell, navigation and content regions rather than provide navigation items.
